Experienced Advocates
Nearly three decades of courtroom practice across twelve disciplines. The partner who advises you at the first consultation is the advocate who argues your matter — briefs are not quietly reassigned.
Monday – Friday: 9:30 AM – 7:00 PM
Bar Council of Delhi-NCR · Since 1997
A full-service practice advising individuals, families and businesses across 12 areas of law. You will get a candid assessment of where you stand — and the shortest defensible route to resolving it.
About the Firm
Singla & Singla Law Firm is a premier full-service legal practice based in Delhi-NCR delivering trusted advocacy since 1997. Built on over two decades of legal excellence, our firm provides strategic representation across Criminal, Civil, Matrimonial law and other legal matters.
We combine deep courtroom expertise with a nuanced, client-first approach to protect rights and resolve complex disputes effectively. From defending intricate criminal matters to navigating sensitive family dynamics and commercial conflicts, our team is committed to upholding justice with unwavering integrity. At Singla & Singla, we offer clear, results-driven solutions designed to safeguard our clients' interests at every stage of litigation.
Practice Areas
We practise in 12 areas of law, from corporate structuring and taxation to criminal defence, family matters and property disputes.
Why Choose Us
Six commitments we hold ourselves to on every matter — each one something you can hold us to in turn.
Every instruction is privileged from the first conversation, before any engagement is agreed. Enquiries are stored securely, and no client name or matter detail is published without express written consent.
Fees are quoted before work begins, in a written engagement letter. Court fees, stamp duty and government charges are always itemised separately from professional fees, so nothing is buried.
Website enquiries are acknowledged immediately and answered within one working day. For arrest, detention or search matters, the office line reaches our criminal practice partner outside working hours.
Documentation is drafted for your facts rather than adapted from a template, and strategy is set around the outcome you actually need — which is not always the one a court can order.
We give you the honest merits of your case, including when litigation is the wrong route or the claim is weak. Where a matter falls outside our competence, we refer it on rather than accept the brief.
Client Testimonials
Outcomes matter, but so does the experience of being represented. These are clients describing both.
Our Team
The partner who takes your first consultation retains the brief and appears in it. Here is who that could be.
Enrollment no.-D-844/1997(R)
Book your consultation today. You will get a candid assessment of your position, a realistic timeline and a fee quote — before you commit to anything.
Frequently Asked
If your question is not answered here, ask it directly — we would rather answer it before you engage us than after.
You can book in three ways: submit the enquiry form on our contact page, message us on WhatsApp, or telephone the office during working hours. Form enquiries receive an acknowledgement email immediately and a substantive response within one working day. When you enquire, please mention the practice area and a one-line summary of the issue so we can allocate the matter to the right partner before we call you back.
Get In Touch
Tell us about your matter and we will respond within one working day. Every enquiry is confidential from the moment it reaches us.
Messages answered during office hours.
